items.title: Hypolite Charles Interview, 1963-04-13
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] ... Bolo was playing sax on some of the same records.

ctx.x: No, just, Boccai was at it. Paul Barnes, Bolo was playing sax on some of the same records. Sidney Bashe, you heard him? Plenty. I met him once.
Well Sidney Bashe was the clarinet player with them. With which? With the Eagle band. Oh yeah. That was his band. That's right.
